[center][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
[color=#b4a7d6]This mod replaces the vanilla [color=#9B45FF]Wizard Catalogue[/color]. The new look is more decadent and magical, but keeping the book clutter.
I wanted the catalogue to be more decorative and cohesive with my other furniture.
